title: Why Compound Lifts Still Beat Machines
excerpt: The case for barbells over circuits, even when your goal isn't a podium — and how to scale them safely.
body:
## Why barbells beat machines

Machines are convenient, but they take away the demand on stabilising muscles. When you squat with a barbell, your trunk, glutes and ankles all work together — that carryover is what changes how you move outside the gym.

### Where to start

- Goblet squat → Front squat → Back squat
- Romanian deadlift → Conventional deadlift
- Strict press → Push press

Progress is steady, not heroic. Add a kilo, sleep, repeat.

title: Sprint Mechanics: 3 Cues That Drop 10ths
excerpt: What our coaches look for on the high-speed cameras, and three simple drills you can do today.
body:
Sprinting is a skill, not just an effort.

1. **Tall posture** — pelvis under ribs.
2. **Aggressive arm action** — hand from hip to chin.
3. **Push the ground** — full hip extension on every step.

Video your runs from the side. The fixes show up fast.

title: Long-Term Athletic Development for Teens
excerpt: Why under-17s should focus on movement quality before chasing 1RMs — and what that looks like in our youth programs.
body:
Under-17 athletes have a window for movement learning that closes fast.

Focus the first 18 months on: bodyweight control, jumping & landing, sprinting mechanics, and consistent strength foundations. Loading comes later.
